description: Colour photograph of a mechanic using a digital torque wrench on a V8 engine cylinder head. A red double-headed arrow runs along the length of the wrench between two white end bars and is labelled X.
Rendered image of a face shield worn on a grey mannequin head: a blue headband with side pivots holds a clear transparent visor that covers the face from forehead to chin.

A four-column table headed Category, Material, Electrical Property and Use. The Conductor row is filled in with Copper, "Allows current to pass through" and Electrical wire; the Insulator and Semiconductor rows are blank.

Exploded pictorial view of a handheld games console in teal green: from the top, the front casing with screen aperture and button holes, the printed circuit board, the button and joypad assembly, the rear casing, a cylindrical battery and the battery cover.
Black-and-white line drawing of a desk stapler in pictorial view, showing the hinged top arm, the magazine body and the flat base with its anvil.

A circuit diagram: a variable resistor R1 and a thermistor R2 in series as a potential divider feeding a transistor through R3, with a diode across a relay coil in the collector line and the relay contacts switching a motor M.
A circuit diagram of a 555 timer between two supply rails: R1 and R2 in series to pins 7, 6 and 2, C1 from pin 2 to 0V, C2 on pin 5, pins 4 and 8 to +V and pin 1 to 0V, with the output at pin 3.
A control chart: Sample Value from 38 to 42 against Time from 0 to 25, with a UCL line at 41.5, an Average line at 40 and an LCL line at 38.5, and the plotted samples scattered about the average.
Colour photograph of four identical flat-pack cardboard cartons standing upright on a steel bench, with a person reaching between two of them.

A circuit diagram between two supply rails with a switch in the top rail: a resistor above an electrolytic capacitor A in series, the junction feeding a transistor B through a resistor, with an LED and resistor in the collector line.

The EU rescaled energy label for a Samsung television: the ENERGY heading with a QR code, the A-to-G coloured arrow scale with a black G marker, 98 kWh/1000h for standard mode, a second HDR panel reading 112 kWh/1000h, and a screen-size diagram giving 3840 x 2160 px and a 108 cm (43 inch) diagonal.

Exploded pictorial view of a castor wheel assembly, its parts numbered 1 to 5 with leader lines: the top mounting plate (1), the axle bolt (2), two side brackets (3), two bearing washers (4) and the wheel itself (5).

Outline line drawing of a handheld cordless vacuum cleaner in pictorial view, drawn unshaded in a ruled box: the tapered nozzle and dust bowl at the front, the body with its switch and slide control, and the loop handle at the rear.

Colour photograph of a small push-type solenoid: a plated steel frame holding a blue-wrapped coil, with a cylindrical plunger projecting from the left face and red and black flying leads with a white connector at the top.

A circuit diagram between +V and -V rails: a variable resistor A above a thermistor B form a potential divider feeding a transistor through a resistor; a push switch C and the transistor output feed an OR gate D that drives a buzzer.
Colour photograph of a pair of blue plastic bevel gears in mesh: a small pinion standing at right angles above a much larger bevel wheel with a keyed centre bore.
A circuit diagram: a battery, a single-pole switch, a resistor labelled R and a light emitting diode with two emission arrows, all in one series loop.
Outline line drawing of a USB flash drive in pictorial view, drawn unshaded in a ruled box, with its cap lying separately to the right and the metal connector exposed.

Colour photograph of a robotic deck-cleaning machine in side view: a low black wedge-shaped body with a vented top, running on wheels over timber decking, with a rotary brush turning underneath its front.

A circuit diagram between 6V and 0V rails with a switch in the top rail: a variable resistor A above a thermistor B form a potential divider feeding a transistor through a resistor, with a buzzer C in the collector line.
A logic circuit diagram drawn with two gates. Inputs A and B enter an OR gate labelled X; its output, labelled C, feeds a NOT gate (inverter) labelled Y, whose output is labelled D.
Colour photograph of corrugated cardboard packaging: a stack of flat die-cut carton blanks behind three small assembled cube-shaped boxes, one of them open.

Colour photograph of a prefabricated timber-framed facade panel with a window and cladding being craned into place on a partly built timber-frame building. The panel is labelled A and the concrete floor slab beneath it is labelled B; two workers in helmets and harnesses guide it in.
Colour photograph of a table lamp made from three upright copper pipes of different heights set into a solid timber base, each pipe topped with a brass lampholder and an exposed-filament bulb.
Pictorial drawing of a single-digit seven-segment LED display: a black rectangular body with all seven red segments and the decimal point lit, and five connection pins projecting from each long side.

Line drawing of a three-blade horizontal-axis wind turbine, drawn in a ruled box. Leader lines label the rotor blades as Rotor, the housing behind the hub as Nacelle (contains gears and generator), and the mast as Cylindrical tower.

Diagram of a compound gear train of four spur gears. Gear A, the driver, has 8 teeth and turns at 450 RPM; it meshes with Gear B, 24 teeth; Gear C, 8 teeth, shares B's shaft and meshes with Gear D, 24 teeth. Each gear is named by a red leader line.

A circuit diagram between +9 V and 0 V rails. A switch feeds two potential-divider branches: component A, a variable resistor, in series with a 10 kilohm resistor, and component B, a thermistor, in series with a second 10 kilohm resistor. The two junctions feed the inverting and non-inverting inputs of an IC comparator, whose output drives a resistor, a transistor and a buzzer back to the 0 V rail.
An assembly sequence in six captioned pictures joined by arrows: Assemble chassis, Install circuit board, Install flat screen, Install speakers, Final assembly and Inspection.
Outline line drawing of an electric kettle in pictorial view, drawn unshaded in a ruled box: the tapered jug with its spout, hinged lid, handle and water-level window, standing on its power base.
Colour photograph of a red miniature toggle switch with six pins, above its circuit symbol: a double-pole double-throw switch drawn as two linked blades each able to meet either of two contacts.
Colour photograph of a black aluminium LED pocket torch lying at an angle, with a knurled grip band, a pocket clip and a reflector lens at the left end.
Colour photograph of a white S-Works road bicycle with deep-section black wheels, standing on a road in front of desert hills.

Colour photograph looking up at a suspension bridge from beneath. A red leader line labels the thin hangers running down from the main cable as Vertical cables, and a second labels the roadway box girder as Deck; a tower stands in the water in the background.
A carbon-film resistor photographed at an angle beside the caption "Resistor bands:" and the list Brown, Black, Red, Gold, which are the four bands printed on it from left to right.

Exploded pictorial view of a garden lantern, its parts spaced out vertically: the wire carrying handle, a small finial, the domed green top cover, the yellow cylindrical glass shade, a green collar, a grey cylindrical candle unit and the domed green base.

Two images joined by an arrow: on the left a square side table with a black top and a chrome tubular frame; on the right, at the end of the arrow, a smartphone lying on that black surface showing a green charging indicator.

The pin layout of an eight-pin integrated circuit drawn as a plain rectangle with four leads on each side. The pin numbers read 7, 4 and 8 across the top, 6 and 3 in the middle, and 2, 1 and 5 across the bottom.
Colour photograph of three laser-cut plywood trophies, each a latticed football on a tapered tower bearing a Fantasy Champion 2017 shield.
Colour photograph of a transparent rigid plastic punnet of strawberries with a hinged clip-shut lid.
Outline line drawing of an angle-poise desk lamp in pictorial view, drawn unshaded in a ruled box: the conical shade, the two-part jointed arm and the weighted domed base.

The pneumatic symbol for a double-acting cylinder: a rectangular barrel containing a piston and a piston rod that passes out through the right-hand end, with hatching drawn inside the barrel and a port stub beneath the left-hand end.

A circuit diagram of a 555 monostable between +V and 0V rails: two resistors from +V, a push switch, the 555 with pins 8, 4, 6, 7, 2 and 1 marked and its output at pin 3, and an electrolytic capacitor C.
Illustration of a yellow mobile crane with its telescopic boom raised to the left, its hook carrying a pale trapezoidal load labelled 1200 N.

Outline line drawing of a games controller, drawn in a ruled box: the symmetrical body with two shoulder buttons, a left thumbstick and a four-way directional pad on the left, minus and plus buttons and two small buttons in the centre, and four round face buttons with a right thumbstick on the right.
Colour rendering of a park bench with white precast concrete end legs and armrests and horizontal timber slats forming the seat and the backrest.

Rendered diagram of a diving springboard in a ruled box. A leader line labels the tubular handrail assembly Ladder and the blue board Springboard, and an angle drawn between the board and its fulcrum mounting is labelled Tilt Angle.

A cost graph: cost from 0 to 8000 against Quantity from 0 to 400, a steep blue line A from the origin and a shallower red line B from 3000, crossing at point C above 200, with the region X between them before C shaded green and the region Y after it shaded pink.
Rendered pictorial view of a chain drive: a small toothed sprocket above and a much larger toothed sprocket below, both with keyed bores, joined by a roller chain running around them.

Line drawing of a disposable takeaway coffee cup, drawn in outline on a lightly hatched square inside a ruled box: a domed lid with a drinking hole, a sleeve carrying a coffee-bean motif, and the tapered cup below it.
A circuit diagram: a 12V battery feeding two 10 Ω resistors in series, with a 40 Ω resistor and a voltmeter V in parallel with each other between them.

Outline line drawing of a cordless drill in pictorial view, drawn unshaded in a ruled box: the chuck and bit at the front, the motor body, the pistol grip with its trigger, and the battery pack below.
A lever diagram: a horizontal bar on a triangular fulcrum at its left end, a 250 N load 50 mm from the fulcrum, and an upward effort arrow 200 mm beyond the load at the right end.
Colour photograph of a hand holding a blue jigsaw by its handle, the blade below the base plate, with a red double-headed arrow along the blade showing its up-and-down motion.

A fishbone (cause and effect) diagram: a grey fish skeleton with four cause boxes on its ribs labelled People, Material, Method and Environment, each with an empty dashed box beside it except Material, whose box reads Oxidised.

Two panels: on the left a ruled drawing box with a black dot at the crossing of two dashed centre lines; on the right a colour photograph of a wooden fishing automaton, a seated figure holding a rod over a wave, labelled Fishing rod, Drive shaft, Cam and Handle.
Colour photograph of a child’s climbing arch: a curved wooden frame with a round hand-hole at each foot and pastel-coloured rungs across the top.

An op-amp circuit diagram: a triangle labelled IC with inverting (-) and non-inverting (+) inputs on the left, between an upper and a lower supply rail, with the output to the right and no components fitted.
Colour photograph of a petrol multi-function gardening tool, the engine at the top of a long shaft, with an inset of its orange strimmer head labelled Safety guard by a red arrow.
Three colour photographs of the gardening tool’s modular heads: a hedge-trimmer blade, a chainsaw bar and the orange strimmer head.
Colour photograph of a green floor-standing pillar drill: the motor and chuck at the top of a steel column, a machine vice on the table and a heavy cast base.
A yellow triangular warning sign with a black border showing a figure tripping over a raised step.
A circuit diagram: a battery feeding a motor M through a double-pole double-throw switch outlined in a red dashed box and labelled Switch A, with its two blades linked by a dashed line.
Shaded drawing of a ratchet and pawl: a toothed wheel with a keyed bore and a red arrow showing its rotation, with a pawl on a pivot above it and a red arrow showing the pawl lifting.
Outline line drawing of a pump-action soap dispenser in a ruled box: a tapered bottle with a collar and a pump head whose nozzle points to the right.
Colour photograph of a clear phone cover with a magnetic ring on its back, seen from behind.
A two-row table: Day 1 to 12 across the top and Defects 2, 3, 4, 5, 3, 2, 6, 4, 3, 7, 5, 4 beneath.
Colour photograph of a three-tiered wooden planter box on grass, three stepped troughs on a diagonal frame, with a white arrow labelled A pointing at its front.
A lever diagram: a horizontal bar on a triangular fulcrum, a 40 N downward arrow at the left end 1 M from the fulcrum and a downward force F at the right end 4 M from it.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section A Q8, as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the cordless drill redrawn in outline with the line weights varied. The scheme captions it: Two graphic techniques demonstrated.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section A Q13, as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a shaded three-dimensional cam, circular with one radial step cut into its rim and a centre hole. The scheme captions it: Snail or drop cam.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section A Q15, as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a front elevation of the climbing arch as an inverted U with a ring at each foot, above a plan showing the two side rails and the rungs between them. The scheme prints beside it: Suggested Solution: Any valid alternative solution accepted.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q1(b)(i), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a flowchart from Start through Move to a shelf, Turn on camera and Scan stock to the decision Is stock full, whose No branch leads to Send alert and whose Yes branch leads to Move to next shelf and loops back to Move to a shelf. The scheme prints beside it: Suggested solution, Alternatives accepted.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q2(a)(i), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a logic circuit in which Fingerprint sensor and PIN Code feed an OR gate, whose output and Power Level feed an AND gate, whose output is Unlock. The scheme prints beside it: Suggested solution, Alternatives accepted.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q2(a)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a truth table with columns Fingerprint sensor, PIN Code, Power Level and Unlock, eight rows from 0 0 0 0 to 1 1 1 1, with Unlock at 1 in the rows 0 1 1, 1 0 1 and 1 1 1.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q2(b)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the op-amp wired as a comparator between 9 V and 0 V rails, a potential divider of a variable resistor and an LDR feeding the inverting input A, R1 and R2 feeding the non-inverting input B, and the output driving an LED through a resistor, labelled Input: Potential divider eg variable resistor with LDR shown, and LED output.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q4(b)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a control chart titled Control chart, the twelve daily defect counts plotted as a line on a 0 to 8 scale, a solid Mean line at 4 and dashed UCL and LCL lines at 7.3 and 0.7.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q5(b)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a sectioned injection moulding machine labelled plastic granules, hopper, heaters, mould cavity, casing mould, screw, barrel, nozzle and moveable plate.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section B Q3(d), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a table with rows Air transport, Land transport and Sea transport against columns Carbon emissions and Pollution, giving each mode's share of global CO2 and grams of CO2 per tonne-km, and the pollutants it emits.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Section C Q5(d), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a table comparing Composite materials with Treated softwood timber row by row under Fabrication techniques, Maintenance and Sustainability.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 OL Section A Q4, as the State Examinations Commission printed it: an elevation of the three-tiered planter box in outline, three shelves of equal width stepped one above the other between two uprights. The scheme prices it by quality: (8,6,4,2 Marks).

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 OL Section B Q2(b)(iii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a sectioned injection moulding machine labelled Hopper, Heater, Ram, Mould, Hydraulic fluid, Screw and Motor, beside the words Injection moulded.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 OL Section C Q1(b)(i), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a flowchart from Start to the decision Button?, whose N branch loops back and whose Y branch runs LEDs On, Wait 2, Motor On, Melody On (dashed), Wait 15, LEDs Off, Motor Off and Melody Off (dashed) before looping back to Start; the dashed boxes are the modification (iii) asks for.
The marking scheme's own answer to 2021 HL Section C Q2(a)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a square wave labelled A Digital signal above a sine wave labelled An Analogue signal.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2021 HL Section C Q2(b)(iii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the 555 astable circuit between 6V and 0V rails with R1, R2, C1 and C2, its pin 3 output driving a transistor through a resistor and an LED in the collector line. The scheme prints beside the part: See diagram above.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2023 OL Section C Q1(b)(i), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a flowchart from Start to the decision On?, whose N branch loops back and whose Y branch runs LED On, Wait 2s, Motor On, Wait 30s, Motor Off, LED On and back to the decision.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2023 OL Section C Q1(b)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the flowchart modified so that after Start and the decision On?, the Y branch runs LED On, Wait 2s, Motor On, Music On, Wait 30s, Motor/Music Off, LED On and loops back. The scheme prints beside it: Any valid alternative solution accepted.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2025 OL Section C Q1(b)(i), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: a flowchart from Start to the decision Button, whose N branch loops back and whose Y branch runs Gate opens, Wait 30, the decision Object?, Gate closes, Wait 10 and back to Start; the dashed Y branch leaving Object? is cut at the edge.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2025 OL Section C Q1(b)(iii), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the lower part of its flowchart, where the decision Object? after Wait 30 sends a Y branch, drawn dashed, to a red Stop box before Gate closes and Wait 10. The scheme prints beneath it: Any valid alternative solution accepted.
